examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A full year of daily Azion platform contributions. Hover or focus any day to inspect its count, and click a day to select or clear it.

examples.name: Loading
examples.summary: A Skeleton placeholder holds the space of the calendar while contributions load.

examples.name: Empty
examples.summary: No activity recorded: renders an empty placeholder state when no items or year are supplied.

examples.name: Error
examples.summary: When contributions fail to load, a bordered empty state with the error message replaces the grid and is announced as an alert.

examples.name: Markdown
examples.summary: The same graph written in a docs page: `DocMarkdown` turns a `<ContributionGraph year={2026} items={[…]} />` tag into a real `ContributionGraph`. The attribute values are JSON, so a docs author copies them from the props or a page entry and never imports the component.

examples.name: Page JSON
examples.summary: The same graph in the marketing site's page JSON: `ContributionGraph` is a scene, so a band places it by name in its `scene` slot (here `console-showcase-section` with `variant: "diagram"`) and `SitePage` renders the entry with no code.
